From 4am Monday, 4 April 2022
  • Parramatta Rd before Burwood Rd (213412) will be closed.
    The alternative stop for 415, 461X, 461N and 530 services will be Burwood Rd at Esher Lane (213431).
  • Parramatta Rd after Burwood Rd (213722) will be closed.
    The alternative stop for 415, 416X, 461N and 530 services will be Burwood Rd before Parramatta Rd (213462).

    Customers for the N70, N71, N80 and N81 services should use the new stop on Parramatta Rd, after Burwood Rd (213460).
  • Parramatta Rd after Burwood Rd (213722) will be closed.
    Customers for the N70, N71, N80 and N81 towards City Town Hall should use the alternate stop on Parramatta Rd opp Neichs Pde (213721).

infoLinks.urlText: Some trains at Hawkesbury River and Cowan leave from different platforms.  If travelling to Cowan you may need to change at Hawkesbury River for a bus
infoLinks.content:
Saturday 6 December  
  • From 5.30am to 11am, at Hawkesbury River and Cowan, all trains leave from platform 2.
  • From 7am to 11.30am, trains towards Hornsby do not stop at Cowan.
  • Buses run from Hawkesbury River to Cowan, and from Cowan to Berowra, in that direction only.
  • Change at Hawkesbury River for a bus to Cowan. From Cowan, catch a bus to Berowra then change for a train to continue your journey.
  • Trains towards Gosford continue to stop at Cowan.

  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.
Bus route
50CN Hawkesbury River, Cowan, Berowra (in that direction only)
 
Replacement buses
  • Most replacement buses are Opal-enabled. Tap on and off with a valid Opal or contactless card. Fines apply without a valid ticket.
  • Bikes aren’t allowed on replacement buses. Use a nearby bike shed or locker.
  • Services may be delayed or cancelled due to driver shortages. We're working to minimise disruptions and keep your journey safe.

infoLinks.urlText: Parramatta bus diversions for A-League match
infoLinks.content:
Road closures will be in place from 9:30pm to 10pm approximately on sections of O’Connell St, Ross St and Victoria Rd on Saturday 29 November following an A-League match at CommBank Stadium.
 
The following bus stops will be closed and routes 546, 549, 550, 600, 601 and 606 will be diverting while road closures are in place. Walk to nearby alternative stops, see the road closure and transport map for more details:
 
Closed and alternative stops:
  • Parramatta Leagues Club, O'Connell Street will be closed
    • Alternative stop O’Connell Street opp Harold Street (for services towards the Hills and North West)
  • Our Lady of Mercy College, O'Connell Street will be closed
    • Alternative stop O’Connell Street at Fennell Street (for services towards Parramatta Station)
  • Victoria Road after Villiers Street will be closed
    • Alternative stop All Saints Anglican Church, Victoria Road (for services towards Parramatta Station)
  • Victoria Road before Marist Place will be closed
    • Alternative stop O’Connell Street opp Harold Street (for services towards the Hills, Epping and Macquarie Park) 
Check signs at stops and see the event page for more info

infoLinks.urlText: Surry Hills bus diversions for Christmas Fair
infoLinks.content:
From 7am until 11:30pm on Saturday 13 December, route 304 services will be diverting around Crown St and missing stops between Albion St and Cleveland St while road closures are in place for the City of Sydney’s Surry Hills Christmas Fair.
 
Services towards Bondi Junction will be diverting via Cleveland St, South Dowling St, Fitzroy St and Foveaux St.
 
Services towards Marrickville will be diverting via Albion St, Flinders St, South Dowling St and Cleveland St.
 
Use alternative stops further along Crown St or Baptist St. Check signs at bus stops for alternative stop locations. 
 
Missed stops:
  • Crown St at Miles St (Stop ID 201021)
  • Crown St at Arthur St (stop ID 201022)
  • Crown St before Foveaux St (stop ID 201023)
  • Crown St opp Lansdowne St (stop ID 201098)
  • Crown St at Rainford St (stop ID 201092)
  • Crown St at Foveaux St (stop ID 201093)

urlText: Buses replace Inner West trains between Strathfield and Central
content:
Monday 1 and Tuesday 2 December 
  • Nightly from 9.20pm to 1.30am, buses replace Inner West trains between Strathfield and Central. Express trains continue to run.
  • Trains run to a changed timetable between Liverpool and Lidcombe only. Change at Lidcombe for T1 trains towards Central.
  • T1 trains make extra stops at Flemington, Homebush and Burwood. Some T9 trains make extra stops at Croydon and Ashfield.
Train and light rail trackwork in the City may also affect how you travel
  • Trains do not run on the City Circle, or between Central and Wynyard. L2 and L3 light rail services do not run between Circular Quay and Juniors Kingsford or Randwick.
  • Buses replace City Circle trains and light rail services in one direction only. From Central, buses stop Museum, St James, Circular Quay, Wynyard, Town Hall and Central.

  • For travel in the City use metro services between Central, Martin Place and Gadigal (Town Hall), or use replacement buses to other City stations.

  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.
Bus routes
44T2 Strathfield, all stations to Stanmore, Central and return
47T2 Strathfield, all stations to Central and return
10CC Central, Museum, St James, Circular Quay, Wynyard, Town Hall, Central and return
 
Replacement buses
  • Most replacement buses are Opal-enabled. Tap on and off with a valid Opal or contactless card. Fines apply without a valid ticket.
  • Bikes aren’t allowed on replacement buses. Use a nearby bike shed or locker.
  • Services may be delayed or cancelled due to driver shortages. We're working to minimise disruptions and keep your journey safe.
subtitle: Buses replace Inner West trains between Strathfield and Central

infoLinks.urlText: Opal can be used between Wollongong and Moss Vale, Exeter and Bundanoon stations.
infoLinks.content:
If travelling by Coach between Wollongong station and Moss Vale, Exeter or Bundanoon stations you can use your Opal card or contactless card or device to tap on or off at your origin/destination station provided the origin/destination is an Opal enabled station.

If travelling onto Goulburn, or other Opal enabled station along the Southern Highlands Line, you should not tap off when transferring from Coach to an Intercity train but instead tap off at your destination station.

Booking is not required for Opal customers on this route.

infoLinks.urlText: Trains run to a changed timetable and stopping pattern due to City Circle trackwork
infoLinks.content:
Monday 1 and Tuesday 2 December   
  • Nightly from 9.50pm to 1.30am, trains via the Airport start and end at Central due to City Circle trackwork.
  • T8 trains do not run between Sydenham and the City. T4 trains run between Sydenham and Bondi Junction, making extra stops at St Peters and Erskineville.
Train and light rail trackwork in the City may also affect how you travel
  • Trains do not run on the City Circle, or between Central and Wynyard. L2 and L3 light rail services do not run between Circular Quay and Juniors Kingsford or Randwick.
  • Buses replace City Circle trains and light rail services in one direction only. From Central, buses stop Museum, St James, Circular Quay, Wynyard, Town Hall and Central.

  • For travel in the City use metro services between Central, Martin Place and Gadigal (Town Hall), or use replacement buses to other City stations.

  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.
Bus route
10CC Central, Museum, St James, Circular Quay, Wynyard, Town Hall, Central (loop service)
 
Replacement buses
  • Most replacement buses are Opal-enabled. Tap on and off with a valid Opal or contactless card. Fines apply without a valid ticket.
  • Bikes aren’t allowed on replacement buses. Use a nearby bike shed or locker.
  • Services may be delayed or cancelled due to driver shortages. We're working to minimise disruptions and keep your journey safe.
